content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Research Associate I Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IIT Roorkee Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download IIT Roorkee Research Associate I Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Associate I : PhD in Hydrology/ Water Resources Engineering/ Civil/ Agricultural Engineering with engineering background at Masters (M. Tech or M.E.) level. Experience in large data handling, hydrological models, big data, R/ Python/ MATLAB, fieldwork, and paper writing with at least one Q1 journal publication.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Associate I : 58,000 per month + HRA

content_sections.heading: How-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) for project-based research positions under the Department of Hydrology.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post is Research Associate-I (PDF) under the Department of Hydrology with a total of 1 vacancy.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Associate-I position will receive a salary of Rs. 58,000 per month plus HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD in Hydrology, Water Resources Engineering, Civil Engineering, or Agricultural Engineering with an engineering background at the Masters level.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any prior experience required for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need experience in large data handling, hydrological models, big data, R/Python/MATLAB, fieldwork, and paper writing with at least one Q1 journal publication.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via Walk-in Interview. Interested candidates must directly appear at the designated interview venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q7. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Associate-I (PDF) position is scheduled to be held on 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Do candidates need to pay any application fee?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned in the official notification for attending this walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring an application on plain paper, a detailed CV, a list of publications, self-attested copies of educational and experience certificates, and original documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website for IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of the institute at https://www.iitr.ac.in to get further details regarding the recruitment notification.
